questions.question: How many applications did we receive in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases WHERE received_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND received_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: How many documents have analysts reviewed since May 2025?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents_reviewed FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What share of applications in 2026 were for business accounts?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN customer_type = 'business' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS business_pct FROM caseflow.cases WHERE received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'

questions.question: How many documents were escalated to Financial Crime in September 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS escalated FROM caseflow.documents WHERE outcome = 'escalate' AND reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-10-01'

questions.question: What were the three most common reasons for asking the applicant for something else, from May to October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS documents FROM caseflow.documents WHERE outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-05-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY documents DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What share of applications received in 2026 got at least one ask-applicant?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM caseflow.documents d WHERE d.case_id = c.case_id AND d.outcome = 'ask_applicant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS ask_applicant_pct FROM caseflow.cases c WHERE c.received_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'

questions.question: What was our turnaround in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: How did turnaround change month by month in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime(decided_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How does turnaround for business applications compare with personal ones, from August to October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_type, MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY customer_type

questions.question: What is our backlog right now?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents_waiting FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'open'

questions.question: How many applications were declined in each month of Q3 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime(decided_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS declined FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status = 'declined' AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Which document type had the highest ask-applicant rate in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT doc_type FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY doc_type ORDER BY AVG(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ask_applicant' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many high-risk applicants were approved in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.customers u ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE u.risk_rating = 'high' AND c.status = 'approved' AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: How many applications were withdrawn in 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrawn FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status = 'withdrawn' AND closed_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'

questions.question: On average, how many minutes does a document review take for business applications and for personal ones?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_type, ROUND(AVG(d.minutes_spent), 1) AS minutes FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.customer_type

questions.question: How many fields did the document pipeline send to the Review queue in the October batch?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fields FROM pipeline.field_results WHERE decision = 'review'

questions.question: Which field went to the Review queue most often in the October batch?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT field FROM pipeline.field_results WHERE decision = 'review' GROUP BY field ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many applications came in through the app each month since March 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime(received_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS applications FROM caseflow.cases WHERE channel = 'app' AND received_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many applications in my region are waiting for the applicant right now?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS waiting FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status = 'waiting_applicant'

questions.question: What is the backlog for each of my teams?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS documents_waiting FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'open' GROUP BY t.team_name ORDER BY t.team_name

questions.question: What was the turnaround for each team in my region in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.team_name, MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name

questions.question: Which analyst in my region reviewed the most documents in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.analyst_name FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.analysts a ON a.analyst_id = d.reviewed_by WHERE d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY a.analyst_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many documents did each team in my region review per working day in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM caseflow.calendar WHERE is_working_day AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-30'), 1) AS per_working_day FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name

questions.question: How many applications in my region had a document sent back to the applicant in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.case_id) AS applications FROM caseflow.documents d WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: How many documents did my team review in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: What is my team's backlog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS documents_waiting FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.reviewed_at IS NULL AND c.status = 'open'

questions.question: What share of my team's documents were accepted in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN outcome = 'accept' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS accepted_pct FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01'

questions.question: Which three reason codes did my team use most in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT reason_code FROM caseflow.documents WHERE reason_code IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY reason_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many applications did each analyst on my team decide in October 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT a.analyst_name, COUNT(*) AS decided FROM caseflow.cases c JOIN caseflow.analysts a ON a.analyst_id = c.analyst_id WHERE c.status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND c.decided_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND c.decided_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY a.analyst_name

questions.question: What was my team's turnaround in Q3 2026?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MEDIAN(working_days_open - applicant_wait_days) AS turnaround_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE status IN ('approved', 'declined') AND decided_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND decided_at < DATE '2026-10-01'
